services.name: Montgomery County Hospital District EMS (MCHD)
services.evidence: MCHD operates the county's 911 ambulance service, manages the county's Public Health District and offers a variety of community and professional education programs.

services.name: Houston Fire Department
services.area: City of Houston limits within Montgomery County (Kingwood/Lake Houston fringe)
services.evidence: We operate over 100 ambulances and transport units staffed by highly trained paramedics.

48339.page_note: DSHS roster (2026-10-02): the only 911 licence based in Montgomery County is MCHD (58 vehicles); Conroe (114k) and The Woodlands have no transport licence. Houston city limits extend into Montgomery County (Wikipedia: 'portions of the city extend into Fort Bend and Montgomery counties'); HFD listed for that sliver as the city's transporter (inference from city limits, small population). AUDIT 2026-10-22: held because the Houston FD slice rests only on city limits; no opened page shows HFD (or MCHD) carrying 911 patients in the Houston part of Montgomery County.
48339.second_source: https://www.fisdap.net/blog/pdfs/2022/07/07/customer-spotlight-q-a-montgomery-county-hospital-district (search result, not opened: MCHD-EMS is the 911 EMS provider for Montgomery County, 1,100 sq mi)

services.name: San Angelo Fire Department
services.evidence: The SAFD provides ambulance service to all of Tom Green County, responding to more than 12,500 ambulance calls a year. The Fire Department's EMS provides advanced life support and transports patients to medical facilities within Tom Green County.

48451.page_note: Roster: San Angelo FD (911) + Shannon AirMed 1 (air ambulance, not ground 911). San Angelo is the only city over 20k. Current map also lists Med-Trans Corporation (air medical); SAFD is the ground 911 transporter for the whole county.

services.name: Odessa Fire Rescue
services.area: whole county (904 sq mi; Ector County is ~901 sq mi)
services.evidence: Odessa Fire Rescue has provided emergency medical services since 1973 ... Operates : 9 Mobile Intensive Care Unit ambulances and 5 reserves ... Covers 904 square miles and serves about 200,000 people

48135.page_note: Roster: Odessa Fire Rescue is the only 911 licence based in Ector County. Coverage area equals the county (page does not literally say 'all of Ector County'; it offers smoke detectors to 'homeowners in Odessa and Ector County'). Goldsmith is the only other town (tiny). AUDIT 2026-10-22: held because Ector County ESD 1/2 (created May 2025) planned to station an ambulance outside Odessa (CBS7 2026-05-18) and the 2026-10-15 Yourbasin article 'Ector County expands emergency resources and facilities' could not be opened (403), so no source after it shows who carries 911 patients outside Odessa now.

48453.page_note: ATCEMS page (austintexas.gov/ems/divisions/divisions-information): 'Austin-Travis County EMS serves over 1,300 square miles, including all of Travis County and parts of Williamson and Hays Counties.' BUT Pflugerville moved ambulance service from Allegiance Mobile Health to Travis County ESD 2 effective 2026-10-01 (Community Impact 2026-07-15: 'transition ambulance and emergency medical services from Allegiance Mobile Health to Travis County ESD 2, effective Oct. 1'). Travis ESD 1 (Lago Vista, 6 vehicles) and ESD 11 (TCFR, 2) hold 911 licences, roles not opened. Acadian/AMR Austin licences unexplained. Map's Allegiance row is now outdated.

48491.page_note: Near-A. WilCo EMS (wilcotx.gov/1983, archived 2025): '911 emergency medical services across 1,100 square miles ... 21 ambulances ... all of Williamson County has a dedicated emergency medical presence nearby.' Georgetown FD runs ambulances for city + ESD 8 (Community Impact 2025-03-06: 'With five total ambulances'; ESD 8 and city cost-share fire and EMS). ATCEMS serves 'parts of Williamson' (Austin city portion). Travis ESD 2 serves Pflugerville city (small part in Williamson) since 2026-10-01. Held because Georgetown franchised private ambulances for backup EMS in 2015 and no current source names/ends that franchise. Map is missing ATCEMS and ESD 2.
